name: hooknostic-monorepo
description: Hooknostic — portable lifecycle hooks for coding-agent harnesses

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @hooknostic/agent-plugin run bundle && pnpm --filter @hooknostic/sdk run bundle && tsc --noEmit && pnpm -r --if-present run bundle
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @hooknostic/agent-plugin run bundle && pnpm --filter @hooknostic/sdk run bundle && tsc --noEmit
scripts.bundle: pnpm --filter @hooknostic/agent-plugin run bundle && pnpm --filter @hooknostic/sdk run bundle && pnpm --filter hooknostic run bundle
